proposed_title: Design and run performance-based qualification for field and technical work
description: Define observable task standards, build task-book style performance records, train and calibrate evaluators, code evaluations by context (field, incident, desk, public setting), and maintain currency rules.
rationale: Performance evidence is the only defensible route to credit field and statecraft competence; v1 has no competency for the people who run it, and staffing losses make evaluator capacity a bottleneck.

proposed_title: Mentor and assess practitioners on the job to transmit tacit field and institutional knowledge
description: Plan supervised repetitions, narrate judgment in context, give structured feedback, and record what was observed so formation survives turnover and AI-assisted workflows.
rationale: CLD signals mean entry tasks that used to form judgment are being compressed; formation must be designed and someone must be competent to do it. Indicators mention mentoring 43 times but no competency owns it.

proposed_title: Identify regionally important plant and tree species using diagnostic features and keys
description: Identify species, genus and family from leaves, twigs, bark, fruit and form; use dichotomous keys; know distribution and associated biota.
rationale: Required by SAF Forestry and Forest Technology standards; absent from v1 (1.4.3 covers animals only). Also the field skill that AI plant-ID apps tempt learners to skip, which makes it a validation baseline.

proposed_title: Ground-truth and calibrate remote-sensing and AI products with field measurements
description: Design calibration plots, compare model or imagery outputs with field measurements, quantify error, and feed corrections back to analysts and models.
rationale: The career bridge from field technician to remote-sensing analyst (LC-PW-03). It sits between 1.3.2, 2.1.2 T3 and 7.2.1; DC/FC should decide whether it is new or a rewrite of 2.1.2 T3.

proposed_title: Operate and optimize water and wastewater treatment processes using real-time sensor and control-system data
description: Run treatment unit processes to permit limits, interpret online analyzer and control-system trends, distinguish sensor drift from process change, and act on alarms.
rationale: Large public workforce with registered apprenticeships and state certification but no v1 home; required for pathway LC-PW-05. DB should own module content.

proposed_title: Apply operational-technology cybersecurity practices to environmental monitoring and utility systems
description: Recognize and report OT security risks, follow access and patching procedures for sensors and control systems, and keep manual fallback operations ready.
rationale: Sensor-based monitoring expands the attack surface; no source on environmental OT cybersecurity was read this session, so this is a placeholder for DC/DB to evidence or drop.

proposed_title: Investigate and control environmental public health hazards in food, vectors and zoonotic disease
description: Conduct inspections and investigations, apply epidemiological reasoning to outbreaks and exposures, and select control measures.
rationale: EHAC List 1 requires these areas; county and state environmental health is a major employer absent from v1. DB to scope as an environmental-health module.
